## Compare Books-A-Million to Competitors

C

[Chicago Review Press](/company/chicago-review-press)

Chicago Review Press is an independent publisher with a range of titles in the publishing industry. The company publishes books including biographies, children's nonfiction, history, politics, music, film, and science. Chicago Review Press primarily serves the book trade. It was founded in 1973 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.

B

[Bellwether Media](/company/bellwether-media)

Bellwether Media publishes nonfiction books for beginning and struggling readers within the educational sector. The company offers a range of leveled readers, hi-lo books, and graphic nonfiction, as well as STEM materials that focus on literacy and young readers. Bellwether Media serves libraries, schools, and teachers. It was founded in 2005 and is based in Minnetonka, Minnesota.

B

[Book of the Month](/company/book-of-the-month)

Book of the Month specializes in a subscription-based service offering a selection of new books across various genres. Customers can choose from a curated list of the latest book releases each month and have them delivered to their doorstep. The company primarily caters to individual consumers and book enthusiasts looking for a convenient way to discover and read new books. It was founded in 1926 and is based in Brooklyn, New York.

![Insight Editions Logo](https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/cbi-image-service-prd/modified/a56c7990-b9a0-4779-9ec8-bc6db6901051.png)

[Insight Editions](/company/insight-editions)

Insight Editions is a publishing company. It specializes in books and collectibles within the pop culture and entertainment sectors. It offers a diverse range of products, including art and creativity books, cookbooks, journals, and licensed merchandise from popular franchises. It targets consumers interested in pop culture, entertainment, and creative hobbies. It was founded in 2000 and is based in San Rafael, California.

![Bodybuilding.com Logo](https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/cbi-image-service-prd/original/3cc1e3d0-c964-4a8b-a08c-553b4c06f49e.png)

[Bodybuilding.com](/company/bodybuildingcom)

Bodybuilding.com operates as an online retailer in the health and wellness sector. It offers dietary supplements, including protein powders, pre and post-workout products, vitamins, and muscle performance enhancers, along with fitness gear and accessories. The company serves the fitness and bodybuilding community with products focused on muscle growth, recovery, and overall health. It was founded in 1999 and is based in Boise, Idaho.

[Health Mart](/company/health-mart)

Health Mart operates as a network of independent pharmacies. It provides services such as managing prescriptions and offers health and wellness support. It primarily serves individuals seeking pharmacy services. It was founded in 1982 and is based in San Francisco, California.

# Books-A-Million Customers and Booksellers Donate Nearly $2.9 Million Nationwide in Holiday Book and Toy Drives

![](/assets/img/pr-newswire.11029de.jpg)

## Books-A-Million Customers and Booksellers Donate Nearly $2.9 Million Nationwide in Holiday Book and Toy Drives

PR Newswire

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Dec. 24, 2025

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Dec. 24, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- This holiday season, Books-A-Million customers and booksellers across the country came together to give back in a powerful way. Books-A-Million stores nationwide have collected 214,732 donated books and toys and nearly $2.9 million in charitable contributions, supporting local organizations ranging from children's hospitals to community and literacy-based nonprofits.

[![](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2851655/Books_A_Million___The_truck_is_here.jpg)](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2851655/Books_A_Million___The_truck_is_here.html)

![](https://mma.prnewswire.com/media/2851655/Books_A_Million___The_truck_is_here.jpg)

Each Books-A-Million store selects a local charity partner, ensuring donations directly benefit the communities they serve and reflecting the company's long-standing commitment to meaningful, grassroots giving.

"This was the largest holiday book and toy drive in Books-A-Million's history — a true testament to the passion of our booksellers and the generosity of our customers," said Olivia McDaniel, Vice President of Marketing at Books-A-Million. "Every reader knows books hold a special kind of magic. This holiday season, our communities brought that magic off the page and turned it into something real for children who needed it most."

Nowhere was that generosity more evident than in Alabama, where Books-A-Million is headquartered. Alabama stores alone raised $192,000 and collected 14,651 books and toys for Children's of Alabama.

Donations support the hospital's Sugar Plum Shop, a free holiday shopping experience that allows parents and caregivers of hospitalized children to select gifts for their children without leaving the hospital. The program helps families maintain a sense of normalcy and joy during an otherwise difficult time.

Books-A-Million remains committed to fostering a love of reading and strengthening the communities it serves through charitable initiatives that create lasting impact — especially during the holiday season.

About Books-A-Million  
Books-A-Million is the second-largest bookstore retailer in the United States, with more than 220 stores located primarily across the East Coast, South, and Midwest. Founded in 1917 as a small newsstand in Florence, Alabama, the company has grown into a leading bookseller offering a wide range of books, magazines, toys, and gifts. In addition to its brick-and-mortar locations, Books-A-Million operates a robust online storefront and a popular membership-based loyalty program, the Millionaire's Club, which provides members with exclusive discounts and special offers. Books-A-Million places a strong emphasis on personalized customer service, numerous author events, and a diverse selection of genres and merchandise—catering to a broad spectrum of customers.
